entries.displayName: CDW Baseline - Admin Consent Request Policy
entries.baseName: CDW Baseline - Admin Consent Request Policy
entries.description: CDW CIS L1 baseline admin consent workflow. Enables the admin consent workflow so users can request access to apps that require admin consent rather than being blocked silently. Covers CIS 5.1.5.2. NOTE: notifyReviewers and reminders require at least one reviewer in the reviewers array. The reviewers array uses placeholder GUIDs that MUST be replaced with the customer tenant's actual Global Administrator role template ID, group ID, or user ID before deployment.

entries.displayName: CDW Baseline - Cross Tenant Access Policy Default
entries.baseName: CDW Baseline - Cross Tenant Access Policy Default
entries.description: CDW CIS L1 baseline cross-tenant access default. Sets default to block all inbound/outbound B2B collaboration except where explicitly configured via Organisational settings. Note this also satisfies CIS 8.2.4 (Teams external trial tenants) when paired with Teams external access policy. After deployment, customer-specific allowlist tenants must be added via Organisational settings.

entries.displayName: CDW Baseline - Device Registration Policy
entries.baseName: CDW Baseline - Device Registration Policy
entries.description: CDW CIS L1 baseline device registration policy. Restricts Entra device join to specific groups, limits devices per user, prevents Global Admin auto-add as local admin, controls local admin assignment during Entra join. Covers CIS 5.1.4.1, 5.1.4.2, 5.1.4.3, 5.1.4.4. NOTE: azureADJoin and azureADRegistration use 'all' by default and require allowedGroups/allowedUsers to be populated with customer-specific group IDs to scope to a subset. Adjust to suit customer requirements.

entries.description: CDW CIS L1 baseline directory setting for Microsoft 365 Groups (Group.Unified template). Restricts guest access to groups, blocks guests from being added to groups, restricts who can create M365 groups. Covers CIS 5.1.3.1, 5.1.6.1, related parts of 5.1.6.x.

entries.displayName: CDW Baseline - Password Rule Settings
entries.baseName: CDW Baseline - Password Rule Settings

entries.description: CDW CIS L1 baseline SharePoint Online and OneDrive tenant-level settings (Graph subset only). Disables legacy auth, sets idle session sign-out, blocks unmanaged device sync, restricts comments and notifications. Covers parts of CIS 7.2.1, CIS 7.3.2, parts of CIS 1.3.2. NOTE: Most CIS 7.x SharePoint checks (sharingCapability, defaultSharingLinkType, requireAcceptingAccountMatchInvitedAccount, externalUserExpirationRequired, etc.) are NOT exposed via Graph and require Set-SPOTenant PowerShell. This file covers ONLY what Graph supports today.
